$comment: Declares the INTENDED GitHub Packages visibility for every package.json/contracts/package-lifecycle.json entry whose status is "published". This is a separate small file rather than a new field on package-lifecycle.json entries on purpose: package-lifecycle.json's schema is owned and exhaustively validated by the published @vespeneventures/governance package (packages/governance/src/lifecycle.ts's ENTRY_KEYS allowlist rejects any field it does not recognise), so adding a field there would force a governance version bump and rewritten test fixtures for what is really repository-tooling metadata, not package lifecycle maturity. See scripts/check-package-visibility.mjs, which joins this file against package-lifecycle.json's "published" entries and is deliberately NOT part of `npm run check` (see that script's own header for why) and deliberately DOES NOT invent a default: a "published" lifecycle entry with no matching entry here, or a malformed one, is a gate finding, not a silent pass.
